headword: {近況報告|きんきょうほうこく}

definitions.gloss: update on recent activities; status report on how one has been
definitions.explanation: A report or account of what has been happening recently in one's life, work, or circumstances. Common in letters, reunions, and social media.

examples.japanese: {近況報告|きんきょうほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please give us an update on how you've been.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同窓会|どうそうかい}→同窓会：15875_dousoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{近況報告|きんきょうほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧し{合|あ}った。
examples.english: We shared updates on our lives at the class reunion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧な{近況報告|きんきょうほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}える→添える：13315_soeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧だ。
examples.english: It is common to include a brief update on your life in New Year's cards.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{近況|きんきょう}→近況：14327_kinkyou⟧ (recent situation) and ⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧ (report). Frequently encountered in reunion settings, letters, and social media posts. In Japanese social culture, sharing {近況報告|きんきょうほうこく} is an important way to maintain relationships.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {近況報告|きんきょうほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give an update on one's situation
- {近況報告|きんきょうほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{兼|か}ねて→兼ねる：11668_kaneru⟧: also serving as a life update
- ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧な{近況報告|きんきょうほうこく}: a brief status update

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{近況|きんきょう}→近況：14327_kinkyou⟧: recent situation — the base word; often used in ⟦{近況|きんきょう}→近況：14327_kinkyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いかが→いかが：02846_ikaga⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (How have you been?)
- ⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧: report — the general term for reporting or giving an account
- ⟦{消息|しょうそく}→消息：19242_shousoku⟧: news of someone, whereabouts — more formal; used when you haven't heard from someone in a while
